The left boundary is the coverb 基於 (already in _BARE_NOUN_INTRO_VERBS_TW) and the right boundary is the preposition 對 followed by the determiner 所述, which cannot continue a noun compound - so this is a genuine bare-noun introduction and 所述第三切換操作 has a 先行詞. has_bare_noun_introduction_tw was previously blind to it only because guard (a) treated the prepositional 對 as a compounding character. The six other genuinely-arguable c18 findings still fire post-fix. Ensemble label is over-strict. TIPO 專利審查基準 第二篇第九章 (§26 第2項). Verified by reading the claim.

GOLD LABEL ON A WALKER ARTIFACT. The term 器具經配置使得當 exists nowhere in the draft - it is the pre-R41 over-capture that ran the 經 clause into the noun. c63 introduces the element article-less ('設置於該外殼的孔，其用於接收經配置以收集生物樣本的器具') and every later 該器具 references it, so under the corrected term 器具 the reference HAS antecedent basis (審查基準 §26; article-less first mention is a valid introduction, which is why the bare-noun rescue exists). Same on c79/c80. Claim read 2026-08-17.

ADR-111 SHIFT + GOLD LABEL ON A WALKER ARTIFACT. The term 第二方向垂直 exists nowhere in the draft - it is the pre-R44 V+於 stranding, where 於 is excluded from _NOUN_CHARS so the scan halts AT it and leaves the verb head 垂直 (of 垂直於) glued to the noun. Claim 1 introduces the element article-less in the locative frame '在第二方向上絕大部分重疊' and the very next span references it as '所述第二方向垂直於所述第一方向', so under the corrected term 第二方向 the reference HAS antecedent basis (審查基準 §2.6; an article-less first mention is a valid introduction, which is why the bare-noun rescue exists). The shifted key 第二方向 is still emitted because the bare-noun LOCATIVE-FRAME intro arm (在X上/在X下) is a separately-tracked withheld class, so it is labelled walker_fp under that class rather than legit. Claim read 2026-08-25.

GOLD LABEL ON A WALKER ARTIFACT (outcome 3). The ensemble labelled 主動模式操作 legit_drafting_error, but that string is not an element the drafter ever wrote - it is the element 主動模式 plus the VERB 操作 ("operates in an active mode"). Claim 11 introduces it with the indefinite article in 以一主動模式操作使得…, alongside its siblings 以一第一邊沿模式操作 and 以一第二邊沿模式操作, and claim 12 references 以該主動模式操作的…. So 該主動模式 HAS antecedent basis and the finding is a walker over-capture, not a §112(b) defect. Both sides over-capture; the finding fires only because the INTRO side captured further (through 使得) than the reference side, the R29 desynchronization shape. Confirmed by counting: 主動模式 occurs twice in the claims blob and BOTH occurrences sit inside 主動模式操作, i.e. the drafter never uses 主動模式操作 as a noun. Claim read 2026-08-28 (TW R46).

ADR-111 SHIFT, not an FN - the claim read Christopher delegated (2026-08-28). 耦接 was withheld in R45 on THREE silenced gold-legit; two of them are this draft's c2/c16 and they are shifts, which takes 耦接 from 3 blockers to 1. The text is 其中該驅動電源的該負端耦接該輸出電壓 = 'wherein the NEGATIVE TERMINAL of the driving power supply COUPLES TO the output voltage'. So the element is 負端 and 耦接 is the VERB; 負端耦接 is an over-capture the drafter never wrote. Under the corrected term the defect is REAL and still fires: 負端 occurs 9 times, 8 as the definite 該負端 and one as 之負端, with ZERO indefinite 一負端 introductions (its sibling 正端 is the same, 4 occurrences all 該正端, zero 一正端), so the definite references have no antecedent. Confirmed by the outcome-2 diagnostic rather than by reading alone: adding 耦接 to the trailing denylist REMOVES 負端耦接 and ADDS 負端 on the same claims, and an added key on the same claim is a shift. The REMAINING blocker for 耦接 is TW202529383A c20 第二端子, which does NOT contain the token and adds nothing when 耦接 is stripped - the spurious-intro cascade, the same class as 儲存, and it is intro-side.

R53 definitional frame (reports #490/#491). The claim DEFINES the term in place - '該相固化基材被構成為由相固化單元形成，該相固化單元包含…' - and then refers back to it with 所述/該.
